title: Translation of Black-Box Clinical Prediction Models into Standalone Transparent Nomograms: Temporal External Validation in Heart Transplantation
abstract: arXiv:2609.07610v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We convert black-box clinical prediction models for tabular data into standalone nomograms that can be audited term by term. PRiSM (Partial Responses in Structured Models) takes the shape of each effect and interaction from the source model, not merely which variables mattered, and lets the outcome select and weight them. We tested this in 50,356 heart transplant recipients, with validation in a later era than training. Nomograms from all 5 source models - a public clinical risk score, logistic regression, neural networks, random forests and extreme gradient boosting - met a prespecified noninferiority criterion for discrimination before any further simplification, and generally preserved calibration and clinical net benefit. Those from the 3 machine-learning models showed no detectable difference in discrimination from de novo generalized additive and explainable boosting models, exceeded neural additive models, and carried fewer terms

translated_title: 将黑盒临床预测模型转化为独立的透明列线图：心脏移植中的时间外部验证
translated_abstract: 我们将针对表格数据的黑盒临床预测模型转化为可逐项审计的独立列线图。PRiSM（结构化模型中的部分响应）方法从源模型中提取每个效应和交互作用的具体形状，而不仅仅是识别哪些变量重要，并让结局变量对它们进行选择和加权。我们在50,356名心脏移植受者中对此进行了测试，验证采用了比训练时期更晚的数据。来自所有5个源模型（公开临床风险评分、逻辑回归、神经网络、随机森林和极端梯度提升）的列线图，在进一步简化之前均满足预先设定的区分度非劣效标准，并总体上保持了校准度和临床净获益。来自3个机器学习模型的列线图在区分度上与从头构建的广义可加模型和可解释提升模型无显著差异，优于神经可加模型，且包含的项数更少。
tldr: 该研究提出PRiSM方法，可将黑盒临床预测模型转化为可逐项审计的透明列线图，并在5万余例心脏移植数据的时间外部验证中证明其在保持区分度、校准度和临床净获益的同时实现了模型透明化。
en_tdlr: This study introduces PRiSM, a method that converts black-box clinical prediction models into standalone transparent nomograms, with temporal external validation in over 50,000 heart transplant recipients demonstrating preserved discrimination, calibration, and clinical net benefit.
